title: 14 March 1965: Filming: Help!, Austria
content:
Following two weeks of filming Help! in the Bahamas, The Beatles began work on scenes in the snowy climes of Austria.

Filming began outside the Hotel Edelweiss in Obertauern, where they stayed until they left the country on 22 March 1965. An unused scene involving toboggan hire was shot, after which The Beatles were filmed falling backwards into snow.

Other scenes were filmed on this day of The Beatles’ stand-ins riding a horse-drawn sleigh. The doubles were Cliff Diggins, Mick Dillon, Peter Cheevers and Joe Dunne.

Page last updated: 11 March 2019

  • 1972: The Beatles win Trustees Award at the Grammy Awards
  • 1972: Recording: Mama’s Little Girl by Wings
  • 1971: Mixing: Dear Boy by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1970: John Lennon’s Bag One exhibition opens in Dusseldorf
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Gaumont Cinema, Wolverhampton
  • 1963: Editing, mixing: From Me To You
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
